caption: The drawing depicts the front facade of a church or mission building rendered in grayscale. The structure has a simple, triangular gabled roof topped with a cross at the peak. There are three arched windows evenly spaced along the upper portion of the facade, each with a thick shadow underneath and short horizontal lines extending from the sides. Below, there are three larger arched doorways, with thick shadows cast on the ground and sides, and the lower section of the building is illustrated with a brick or stone pattern. The background is plain and unembellished. Below the illustration, there are two gray, ribbon-like banners; the smaller left banner contains the numbers "1772," and the larger, lower banner contains the words "mission san luis obispo" in a handwritten script style, followed by the signature "J.S. Jones." The drawing is composed solely of black and gray tones on an off-white background.
title: Mision San Luis Obispo
